title: CHANGE_TRUST fails with CHANGE_TRUST_TRUST_LINE_MISSING
pattern: A transaction whose CHANGE_TRUST operation fails at apply is still written into the closed ledger: its fee is charged, its sequence number is consumed, and nothing it did is kept. The result carries the operation's code (trust_line_missing). A pool-share trustline for XLM/NRV from an account with no NRV trustline.

hazards.placement: pool-share trustline without the underlying asset trustline

facts.says: No operation changed state: the operation meta is empty.
The fee is still charged: the fee source changes in fee processing.
